g.text: Each panel shows the four-group interaction (famous AI − unknown twin) − (famous non-AI − general population) with its 95% crossed

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: identity-and-dilemma bootstrap interval (20,000 resamples) on the confirmatory run. The grey hollow marker is the same-answer matched

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: estimate, a descriptive quantity computed only on cells where both members of a pair gave the same yes/no answer. The dashed line in

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: the first panel marks the size of the confidence effect: the yes-rate interval does not exclude an answer shift of that size.
